source: Deriv public tick archive; all dates previously viewed

audit.checks: Selected chunk SHA-256, row counts, bounds, ordering, duplicate/conflict rejection, and every eligible UTC second verified.

methodDefinitions.rule: Rise when SMA10>SMA20; Fall when SMA10<SMA20; otherwise no trade.
Rise when SMA20>SMA50; Fall when SMA20<SMA50; otherwise no trade.
Fall when SMA10>SMA20; Rise when SMA10<SMA20; otherwise no trade.
Fall when SMA20>SMA50; Rise when SMA20<SMA50; otherwise no trade.
Rise only on SMA10 crossing above SMA20; Fall only on crossing below.
Rise only on SMA20 crossing above SMA50; Fall only on crossing below.
Rise when EMA12>EMA26; Fall when EMA12<EMA26.
Fall when EMA12>EMA26; Rise when EMA12<EMA26.
Rise only on EMA12 crossing above EMA26; Fall only on crossing below.
Rise when MACD line is above its 9-period signal; Fall when below.
Rise only on MACD crossing above its signal; Fall only on crossing below.
Rise below the lower 20-period, 2-SD band; Fall above the upper band.
Fall below the lower 20-period, 2-SD band; Rise above the upper band.
Rise when price returns inside the lower band from below; Fall when it returns inside the upper band from above.
Rise when Wilder RSI14<30; Fall when RSI14>70.
Fall when Wilder RSI14<30; Rise when RSI14>70.
Rise only when RSI14 crosses above 50; Fall only when it crosses below 50.
Rise when RSI14 exits below-30 territory upward; Fall when it exits above-70 territory downward.
Rise when SMA10>SMA20 and RSI14>50; Fall when SMA10<SMA20 and RSI14<50.
Rise below lower band only with RSI14<30; Fall above upper band only with RSI14>70.

limitations: The ranking is exploratory because the 30-day archive was already inspected.
The seven missing seconds stay absent and all indicator state resets at that gap.
The platform's indicator and tick-timing parity has not been observed.
Public quotes and assumed payouts are not executable contract terms.
